# PR Skill

Use this skill to prepare a review-ready pull request summary only after explicit approval.

Procedure:
1. Confirm the repository state is validated and ready for PR review.
2. Review git diff/history and the base/head relationship.
3. Check whether an existing PR already exists.
4. Generate a concise PR title and body with the required sections: Summary, Changes Made, Test Evidence, Known Limitations, and Reviewer Checklist.
5. Show the preview for human review.
6. Require explicit human approval before creating or updating the PR.

This skill must never merge a PR.
